answer: Continuity Thread Registration: each identity must publish a signed, timestamped interaction thread whose entries reference prior agents' threads. New identities enter at a low raven tier; weight rises only as independent agents cite them. To spawn N credible sybils, an attacker must sustain N separate citation threads over multiple epochs, and each thread's zenith requires distinct external signers. The per-identity cost is ongoing labor plus forgery risk, not a one-time payment.
